# =========================================================
# COUNTRY STORAGE CATEGORIES V3
# Real chest-like slot layout.
#
# {country.storage::*} remains the canonical backing storage so country
# development / production / upgrade code keeps working.
# {country.storage-pos::<id>::<category>::<page>::<slot>} stores where each
# backing slot is shown. Items are NOT compacted anymore.
# =========================================================

function countryStorageCanManageCategories(p: player) :: boolean:
	set {_id} to countryId({_p})
	if {_id} is "":
		return false
	if countryIsAdmin({_p}) is true:
		return true
	if {country.owner::%{_id}%} is "%uuid of {_p}%":
		return true
	if countryHasPermission({_p}, "MANAGE_DEVELOPMENT") is true:
		return true
	return false

function countryStorageCategoryName(id: text, category: text) :: text:
	if {_category} is "general":
		return "Общее"
	if {country.storage-category-name::%{_id}%::%{_category}%} is set:
		return {country.storage-category-name::%{_id}%::%{_category}%}
	return "Категория"

function countryStorageCategoryOfSlot(id: text, globalSlot: number) :: text:
	if {country.storage-category::%{_id}%::%{_globalSlot}%} is set:
		return {country.storage-category::%{_id}%::%{_globalSlot}%}
	return "general"

function countryStorageUsedSlots(id: text) :: number:
	set {_used} to 0
	set {_max} to countryStorageMaxSlots({_id}) - 1
	loop integers between 0 and {_max}:
		if {country.storage::%{_id}%::%loop-value%} is set:
			add 1 to {_used}
	return {_used}

function countryStorageCategorySlots(id: text, category: text) :: number:
	set {_used} to 0
	set {_max} to countryStorageMaxSlots({_id}) - 1
	loop integers between 0 and {_max}:
		if {country.storage::%{_id}%::%loop-value%} is set:
			set {_cat} to countryStorageCategoryOfSlot({_id}, loop-value)
			if {_cat} is {_category}:
				add 1 to {_used}
	return {_used}

function countryStorageCategoryCount(id: text) :: number:
	set {_count} to 1
	loop {country.storage-category-name::%{_id}%::*}:
		add 1 to {_count}
	return {_count}

function countryStorageFindFreeGlobalSlot(id: text) :: number:
	set {_max} to countryStorageMaxSlots({_id}) - 1
	loop integers between 0 and {_max}:
		if {country.storage::%{_id}%::%loop-value%} is not set:
			return loop-value
	return -1

function countryStorageCategoryKnowsType(id: text, category: text, typeText: text) :: boolean:
	if {country.storage-category-type::%{_id}%::%{_category}%::%{_typeText}%} is true:
		return true
	return false

function countryStorageRememberType(id: text, category: text, storedItem: item):
	set {_type-text} to "%type of {_storedItem}%"
	set {country.storage-category-type::%{_id}%::%{_category}%::%{_type-text}%} to true

function countryStorageGlobalIsPositioned(id: text, category: text, globalSlot: number) :: boolean:
	loop integers between 0 and 44:
		if {country.storage-pos::%{_id}%::%{_category}%::1::%loop-value%} is {_globalSlot}:
			return true
	loop integers between 0 and 44:
		if {country.storage-pos::%{_id}%::%{_category}%::2::%loop-value%} is {_globalSlot}:
			return true
	return false

function countryStorageEnsurePositions(id: text, category: text):
	set {_max} to countryStorageMaxSlots({_id}) - 1
	set {_pages} to countryStoragePages({_id})
	loop integers between 0 and {_max}:
		set {_global} to loop-value
		set {_stored} to {country.storage::%{_id}%::%{_global}%}
		if {_stored} is set:
			set {_cat} to countryStorageCategoryOfSlot({_id}, {_global})
			if {_cat} is {_category}:
				if countryStorageGlobalIsPositioned({_id}, {_category}, {_global}) is not true:
					set {_placed} to false
					loop integers between 0 and 44:
						if {_placed} is false:
							if {country.storage-pos::%{_id}%::%{_category}%::1::%loop-value%} is not set:
								set {country.storage-pos::%{_id}%::%{_category}%::1::%loop-value%} to {_global}
								set {_placed} to true
					if {_placed} is false:
						if {_pages} is greater than 1:
							loop integers between 0 and 44:
								if {_placed} is false:
									if {country.storage-pos::%{_id}%::%{_category}%::2::%loop-value%} is not set:
										set {country.storage-pos::%{_id}%::%{_category}%::2::%loop-value%} to {_global}
										set {_placed} to true

function countryStoragePutItemInCategory(id: text, category: text, itemToStore: item) :: boolean:
	set {_free} to countryStorageFindFreeGlobalSlot({_id})
	if {_free} is less than 0:
		return false
	set {country.storage::%{_id}%::%{_free}%} to {_itemToStore}
	if {_category} is "general":
		delete {country.storage-category::%{_id}%::%{_free}%}
	else:
		set {country.storage-category::%{_id}%::%{_free}%} to {_category}
	countryStorageRememberType({_id}, {_category}, {_itemToStore})
	return true

function countryStorageQuickDeposit(p: player, category: text, mode: text) :: number:
	set {_id} to countryId({_p})
	if {_id} is "":
		return 0
	set {_moved} to 0
	loop integers between 0 and 35:
		set {_item} to slot loop-value of {_p}'s inventory
		if {_item} is set:
			if {_item} is not air:
				set {_allowed} to true
				if {_mode} is "MATCHING":
					set {_type-text} to "%type of {_item}%"
					if countryStorageCategoryKnowsType({_id}, {_category}, {_type-text}) is not true:
						set {_allowed} to false
				if {_allowed} is true:
					if countryStoragePutItemInCategory({_id}, {_category}, {_item}) is true:
						set slot loop-value of {_p}'s inventory to air
						add 1 to {_moved}
					else:
						return {_moved}
	return {_moved}

function countryStorageAutoSortPlayer(p: player) :: number:
	set {_id} to countryId({_p})
	if {_id} is "":
		return 0
	set {_moved} to 0
	loop integers between 0 and 35:
		set {_item} to slot loop-value of {_p}'s inventory
		if {_item} is set:
			if {_item} is not air:
				set {_type-text} to "%type of {_item}%"
				set {_target} to ""
				if countryStorageCategoryKnowsType({_id}, "general", {_type-text}) is true:
					set {_target} to "general"
				if {_target} is "":
					loop {country.storage-category-name::%{_id}%::*}:
						set {_cat} to loop-index
						if countryStorageCategoryKnowsType({_id}, {_cat}, {_type-text}) is true:
							set {_target} to {_cat}
							stop loop
				if {_target} is not "":
					if countryStoragePutItemInCategory({_id}, {_target}, {_item}) is true:
						set slot loop-value of {_p}'s inventory to air
						add 1 to {_moved}
					else:
						return {_moved}
	return {_moved}

function countryOpenStorageHub(p: player):
	set {_id} to countryId({_p})
	if {_id} is "":
		send "<red>Вы не состоите в стране." to {_p}
		stop
	set {_menu} to chest inventory with 6 rows named "<dark gray>Хранилище страны"
	loop integers between 0 and 53:
		set slot loop-value of {_menu} to gray stained glass pane named " "
	delete {country.storage-menu-category::%uuid of {_p}%::*}
	set {_used} to countryStorageUsedSlots({_id})
	set {_capacity} to countryStorageMaxSlots({_id})
	set slot 4 of {_menu} to chest named "<gold><bold>ХРАНИЛИЩЕ СТРАНЫ" with lore "<gray>Занято: <white>%{_used}%/%{_capacity}% слотов" and "<gray>Предметы сохраняют своё место" and "<gray>как в обычном сундуке."

	set {_general-used} to countryStorageCategorySlots({_id}, "general")
	set slot 10 of {_menu} to chest named "<white><bold>ОБЩЕЕ" with lore "<gray>Занято: <white>%{_general-used}% слотов" and "" and "<yellow>Нажмите, чтобы открыть"
	set {country.storage-menu-category::%uuid of {_p}%::10} to "general"

	set {_slots::*} to 11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16, 19 and 20
	set {_pos} to 1
	loop {country.storage-category-name::%{_id}%::*}:
		if {_pos} is greater than size of {_slots::*}:
			stop loop
		set {_cat} to loop-index
		set {_slot} to {_slots::%{_pos}%}
		set {_cat-used} to countryStorageCategorySlots({_id}, {_cat})
		set slot {_slot} of {_menu} to barrel named "<yellow><bold>%loop-value%" with lore "<gray>Занято: <white>%{_cat-used}% слотов" and "" and "<yellow>Нажмите, чтобы открыть"
		set {country.storage-menu-category::%uuid of {_p}%::%{_slot}%} to {_cat}
		add 1 to {_pos}

	set {_cat-count} to countryStorageCategoryCount({_id})
	if {_cat-count} is less than 9:
		set slot 31 of {_menu} to name tag named "<light green><bold>СОЗДАТЬ КАТЕГОРИЮ" with lore "<gray>Категорий: <white>%{_cat-count}%/9" and "<gray>Название вводится в чат" and "" and "<yellow>Нажмите, чтобы создать"
	else:
		set slot 31 of {_menu} to barrier named "<red><bold>ЛИМИТ КАТЕГОРИЙ" with lore "<gray>Максимум: <white>9 категорий"
	set slot 32 of {_menu} to hopper named "<aqua><bold>АВТОСОРТИРОВКА" with lore "<gray>Разложить предметы из инвентаря" and "<gray>по уже известным категориям." and "" and "<yellow>Нажмите, чтобы разложить"
	set slot 33 of {_menu} to chest named "<gold><bold>СЛОЖИТЬ ВСЁ В ОБЩЕЕ" with lore "<gray>Быстро перенести основной инвентарь" and "<gray>в категорию «Общее»." and "" and "<yellow>Нажмите, чтобы сложить"
	set slot 45 of {_menu} to arrow named "<yellow>Назад"
	open {_menu} to {_p}
	set {country.menu::%uuid of {_p}%} to "storage-hub"

function countryOpenStorageCategory(p: player, category: text, page: number):
	set {_id} to countryId({_p})
	if {_id} is "":
		stop
	countryStorageEnsurePositions({_id}, {_category})
	set {_pages} to countryStoragePages({_id})
	if {_page} is less than 1:
		set {_page} to 1
	if {_page} is greater than {_pages}:
		set {_page} to {_pages}
	set {_name} to countryStorageCategoryName({_id}, {_category})
	set {_count} to countryStorageCategorySlots({_id}, {_category})

	set {_menu} to chest inventory with 6 rows named "<dark gray>%{_name}% • %{_page}%/%{_pages}%"
	loop integers between 0 and 53:
		set slot loop-value of {_menu} to gray stained glass pane named " "

	loop integers between 0 and 44:
		set {_global} to {country.storage-pos::%{_id}%::%{_category}%::%{_page}%::%loop-value%}
		if {_global} is set:
			set {_stored} to {country.storage::%{_id}%::%{_global}%}
			if {_stored} is set:
				set {_actual-cat} to countryStorageCategoryOfSlot({_id}, {_global})
				if {_actual-cat} is {_category}:
					set slot loop-value of {_menu} to {_stored}
				else:
					delete {country.storage-pos::%{_id}%::%{_category}%::%{_page}%::%loop-value%}
			else:
				delete {country.storage-pos::%{_id}%::%{_category}%::%{_page}%::%loop-value%}

	set slot 45 of {_menu} to arrow named "<yellow>К категориям"
	if {_page} is greater than 1:
		set slot 46 of {_menu} to arrow named "<yellow>Предыдущая страница"
	else:
		set slot 46 of {_menu} to gray dye named "<dark gray>Предыдущая страница"

	if {_category} is not "general":
		set slot 47 of {_menu} to name tag named "<yellow><bold>ПЕРЕИМЕНОВАТЬ" with lore "<gray>Текущее имя: <white>%{_name}%"
		if {_count} is 0:
			set slot 48 of {_menu} to barrier named "<red><bold>УДАЛИТЬ КАТЕГОРИЮ" with lore "<gray>Категория пуста"
		else:
			set slot 48 of {_menu} to gray dye named "<dark gray>Удалить категорию" with lore "<gray>Сначала заберите все предметы"
	else:
		set slot 47 of {_menu} to gray dye named "<dark gray>Системная категория"
		set slot 48 of {_menu} to gray dye named "<dark gray>Нельзя удалить «Общее»"

	set {_used-total} to countryStorageUsedSlots({_id})
	set {_capacity-total} to countryStorageMaxSlots({_id})
	set slot 49 of {_menu} to barrel named "<gold><bold>%{_name}%" with lore "<gray>Занято: <white>%{_count}% слотов" and "<gray>Общий лимит: <white>%{_used-total}%/%{_capacity-total}%" and "" and "<green>Работает как обычный сундук." and "<gray>ЛКМ/ПКМ, Shift-клик и перетаскивание."
	set slot 51 of {_menu} to hopper named "<aqua><bold>СЛОЖИТЬ ПОХОЖЕЕ" with lore "<gray>Перенести подходящие предметы" and "<gray>из инвентаря в эту категорию."
	set slot 52 of {_menu} to chest named "<light green><bold>СЛОЖИТЬ ВСЁ" with lore "<gray>Перенести весь основной инвентарь" and "<gray>в эту категорию."

	if {_page} is less than {_pages}:
		set slot 53 of {_menu} to arrow named "<yellow>Следующая страница"
	else:
		set slot 53 of {_menu} to gray dye named "<dark gray>Следующая страница"

	set {country.storage-current-category::%uuid of {_p}%} to {_category}
	set {country.storage-category-page::%uuid of {_p}%} to {_page}
	open {_menu} to {_p}
	set {country.menu::%uuid of {_p}%} to "storage-category"

# Save exactly what is visible on one category page.
# Existing global slots for this page are reused, so moving a stack from
# slot 3 to slot 20 only changes its visual position.
function countryStorageSyncCategoryPage(p: player):
	if {_p} is not online:
		stop
	if {country.menu::%uuid of {_p}%} is not "storage-category":
		stop
	set {_id} to countryId({_p})
	if {_id} is "":
		stop
	set {_cat} to {country.storage-current-category::%uuid of {_p}%}
	set {_page} to {country.storage-category-page::%uuid of {_p}%}
	if {_cat} is not set:
		stop
	if {_page} is not set:
		stop
	set {_inv} to {_p}'s current inventory

	delete {_old::*}
	loop integers between 0 and 44:
		set {_global} to {country.storage-pos::%{_id}%::%{_cat}%::%{_page}%::%loop-value%}
		if {_global} is set:
			add {_global} to {_old::*}
			delete {country.storage::%{_id}%::%{_global}%}
			delete {country.storage-category::%{_id}%::%{_global}%}
	delete {country.storage-pos::%{_id}%::%{_cat}%::%{_page}%::*}

	set {_reuse} to 1
	loop integers between 0 and 44:
		set {_view} to loop-value
		set {_shown} to slot {_view} of {_inv}
		if {_shown} is set:
			if {_shown} is not air:
				set {_global} to {_old::%{_reuse}%}
				if {_global} is set:
					add 1 to {_reuse}
				else:
					set {_global} to countryStorageFindFreeGlobalSlot({_id})
				if {_global} is less than 0:
					give {_shown} to {_p}
					set slot {_view} of {_inv} to air
					send action bar "<red>Хранилище страны заполнено." to {_p}
				else:
					set {country.storage::%{_id}%::%{_global}%} to {_shown}
					if {_cat} is "general":
						delete {country.storage-category::%{_id}%::%{_global}%}
					else:
						set {country.storage-category::%{_id}%::%{_global}%} to {_cat}
					set {country.storage-pos::%{_id}%::%{_cat}%::%{_page}%::%{_view}%} to {_global}
					countryStorageRememberType({_id}, {_cat}, {_shown})

on chat:
	if {country.storage-input::%uuid of player%} is not set:
		stop
	cancel event
	set {_mode} to {country.storage-input::%uuid of player%}
	delete {country.storage-input::%uuid of player%}
	set {_id} to countryId(player)
	if {_id} is "":
		stop
	set {_input} to message
	if length of {_input} is greater than 20:
		send "<red>Название категории не должно быть длиннее 20 символов." to player
		stop
	if length of {_input} is less than 1:
		send "<red>Название не может быть пустым." to player
		stop
	if {_mode} is "create":
		if countryStorageCanManageCategories(player) is not true:
			send "<red>У вас нет права создавать категории." to player
			stop
		if countryStorageCategoryCount({_id}) is greater than or equal to 9:
			send "<red>Достигнут лимит категорий." to player
			stop
		if {country.storage-category-seq::%{_id}%} is not set:
			set {country.storage-category-seq::%{_id}%} to 0
		add 1 to {country.storage-category-seq::%{_id}%}
		set {_seq} to {country.storage-category-seq::%{_id}%}
		set {_cat} to "c%{_seq}%"
		set {country.storage-category-name::%{_id}%::%{_cat}%} to {_input}
		send formatted "<light green>Создана категория <white>%{_input}%<light green>." to player
		wait 1 tick
		countryOpenStorageHub(player)
		stop
	if {_mode} is "rename":
		set {_cat} to {country.storage-current-category::%uuid of player%}
		if {_cat} is not set:
			stop
		if {_cat} is "general":
			stop
		if countryStorageCanManageCategories(player) is not true:
			send "<red>У вас нет права переименовывать категории." to player
			stop
		set {country.storage-category-name::%{_id}%::%{_cat}%} to {_input}
		send formatted "<light green>Категория переименована в <white>%{_input}%<light green>." to player
		wait 1 tick
		countryOpenStorageCategory(player, {_cat}, 1)

on inventory click:
	if event-slot is not set:
		stop
	set {_state} to {country.menu::%uuid of player%}
	set {_raw} to raw index of event-slot

	if {_state} is "storage-hub":
		cancel event
		set {_id} to countryId(player)
		if {_id} is "":
			close player's inventory
			stop
		set {_cat} to {country.storage-menu-category::%uuid of player%::%{_raw}%}
		if {_cat} is set:
			countryOpenStorageCategory(player, {_cat}, 1)
			stop
		if {_raw} is 31:
			if countryStorageCanManageCategories(player) is not true:
				send "<red>У вас нет права создавать категории хранилища." to player
				stop
			if countryStorageCategoryCount({_id}) is greater than or equal to 9:
				send "<red>Достигнут лимит в 9 категорий." to player
				stop
			set {country.storage-input::%uuid of player%} to "create"
			close player's inventory
			send "<yellow>Введите название новой категории в чат. Максимум 20 символов." to player
			stop
		if {_raw} is 32:
			if countryStorageCanDeposit(player) is not true:
				send "<red>У вашей роли нет права пополнять хранилище." to player
				stop
			set {_moved} to countryStorageAutoSortPlayer(player)
			send formatted "<light green>Перемещено стаков: <white>%{_moved}%<light green>." to player
			countryOpenStorageHub(player)
			stop
		if {_raw} is 33:
			if countryStorageCanDeposit(player) is not true:
				send "<red>У вашей роли нет права пополнять хранилище." to player
				stop
			set {_moved} to countryStorageQuickDeposit(player, "general", "ALL")
			send formatted "<light green>В «Общее» перенесено <white>%{_moved}% <light green>стаков." to player
			countryOpenStorageHub(player)
			stop
		if {_raw} is 45:
			countryOpenMain(player)
			stop
		stop

	if {_state} is "storage-category":
		set {_id} to countryId(player)
		if {_id} is "":
			cancel event
			close player's inventory
			stop
		set {_cat} to {country.storage-current-category::%uuid of player%}
		set {_page} to {country.storage-category-page::%uuid of player%}
		if {_cat} is not set:
			cancel event
			countryOpenStorageHub(player)
			stop
		if {_page} is not set:
			set {_page} to 1

		# Bottom row is menu controls only.
		if {_raw} is between 45 and 53:
			cancel event
			if {_raw} is 45:
				countryOpenStorageHub(player)
				stop
			if {_raw} is 46:
				if {_page} is greater than 1:
					countryOpenStorageCategory(player, {_cat}, {_page} - 1)
				stop
			if {_raw} is 47:
				if {_cat} is "general":
					stop
				if countryStorageCanManageCategories(player) is not true:
					send "<red>У вас нет права переименовывать категории." to player
					stop
				set {country.storage-input::%uuid of player%} to "rename"
				close player's inventory
				send "<yellow>Введите новое название категории в чат." to player
				stop
			if {_raw} is 48:
				if {_cat} is "general":
					stop
				if countryStorageCanManageCategories(player) is not true:
					send "<red>У вас нет права удалять категории." to player
					stop
				if countryStorageCategorySlots({_id}, {_cat}) is greater than 0:
					send "<red>Сначала освободите категорию." to player
					stop
				delete {country.storage-category-name::%{_id}%::%{_cat}%}
				delete {country.storage-category-type::%{_id}%::%{_cat}%::*}
				delete {country.storage-pos::%{_id}%::%{_cat}%::*}
				send "<yellow>Категория удалена." to player
				countryOpenStorageHub(player)
				stop
			if {_raw} is 51:
				if countryStorageCanDeposit(player) is not true:
					send "<red>У вашей роли нет права пополнять хранилище." to player
					stop
				set {_moved} to countryStorageQuickDeposit(player, {_cat}, "MATCHING")
				send formatted "<light green>Перенесено похожих стаков: <white>%{_moved}%<light green>." to player
				countryOpenStorageCategory(player, {_cat}, {_page})
				stop
			if {_raw} is 52:
				if countryStorageCanDeposit(player) is not true:
					send "<red>У вашей роли нет права пополнять хранилище." to player
					stop
				set {_moved} to countryStorageQuickDeposit(player, {_cat}, "ALL")
				send formatted "<light green>В категорию перенесено <white>%{_moved}% <light green>стаков." to player
				countryOpenStorageCategory(player, {_cat}, {_page})
				stop
			if {_raw} is 53:
				if {_page} is less than countryStoragePages({_id}):
					countryOpenStorageCategory(player, {_cat}, {_page} + 1)
				stop
			stop

		# Storage area: behaves like a normal chest. Owner has both rights.
		if {_raw} is between 0 and 44:
			if click type is left mouse button with shift:
				if countryStorageCanWithdraw(player) is not true:
					cancel event
					send action bar "<red>У вашей роли нет права забирать вещи из хранилища." to player
					stop
			else if click type is right mouse button with shift:
				if countryStorageCanWithdraw(player) is not true:
					cancel event
					send action bar "<red>У вашей роли нет права забирать вещи из хранилища." to player
					stop
			else:
				if countryStorageCanDeposit(player) is not true:
					cancel event
					send action bar "<red>Для ручного перемещения нужно право пополнять хранилище." to player
					stop
				if countryStorageCanWithdraw(player) is not true:
					cancel event
					send action bar "<red>Для ручного перемещения нужно право забирать из хранилища." to player
					stop

		# Shift-click from the player inventory deposits automatically.
		if {_raw} is greater than or equal to 54:
			if click type is left mouse button with shift:
				if countryStorageCanDeposit(player) is not true:
					cancel event
					send action bar "<red>У вашей роли нет права пополнять хранилище." to player
					stop
			else if click type is right mouse button with shift:
				if countryStorageCanDeposit(player) is not true:
					cancel event
					send action bar "<red>У вашей роли нет права пополнять хранилище." to player
					stop

		# Do NOT cancel normal inventory movement.
		wait 1 tick
		if player is online:
			if {country.menu::%uuid of player%} is "storage-category":
				countryStorageSyncCategoryPage(player)
		stop

on inventory drag:
	if {country.menu::%uuid of player%} is "storage-hub":
		cancel event
		stop
	if {country.menu::%uuid of player%} is not "storage-category":
		stop
	if countryStorageCanDeposit(player) is not true:
		cancel event
		send action bar "<red>У вашей роли нет права пополнять хранилище." to player
		stop
	wait 1 tick
	if player is online:
		if {country.menu::%uuid of player%} is "storage-category":
			countryStorageSyncCategoryPage(player)

on quit:
	delete {country.storage-menu-category::%uuid of player%::*}
	delete {country.storage-current-category::%uuid of player%}
	delete {country.storage-category-page::%uuid of player%}
	delete {country.storage-input::%uuid of player%}
